text: This report provides an annual overview of real estate transactions previously executed by the Corporate Real Estate Management Division on behalf of the City of Toronto through the Delegated Authority Form process from January 1, 2020 to December 31, 2020. Properties that were declared surplus, sold, acquired through negotiations or expropriations, as well as licences and leases, are summarized in this report.

City Council on December 15, 16 and 17, 2021, adopted the following: 1. City Council receive the report (November 16, 2021) from the Executive Director, Corporate Real Estate Management for information.
